title: Close Hyperposition bypass and audit every GWT side channel
completion_test_prose: In wide-workspace mode build Hyperposition before the unified candidate list, use stable relation_id, and ensure Hyperposition payload reaches Zero only through winner materialization. Classify every other Prestager/Zero information channel as FRAME, CONTROL, CANDIDATE, TOOL or OUTCOME and prove no answer-bearing CANDIDATE payload bypasses broadcast. Run full, broadcast-lesion, sidechannel-lesion, all-content-lesion and winner-swap arms on held-out tasks. Preserve narrow-mode behavior as comparison control. Whole global-workspace credit remains blocked if any control/frame channel reconstructs answer-specific content under all-content lesion.
rationale_prose: Current ordering builds _gw_kandidaten before hyperposition_readout exists, then injects Hyperposition separately into prestage. The code therefore contains a Hyperposition candidate adapter that the current wide path cannot actually use, while the same content remains visible outside the bottleneck. Rich current_user_profile is another unclassified content-capable side channel.
